an4.262:1.1: catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nālaṃ araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevituṃ.
an4.262:1.3: kāmavitakkena, vyāpādavitakkena, vihiṃsāvitakkena, duppañño hoti jaḷo elamūgo.
an4.262:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nālaṃ araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevitunti.
an4.262:2.1: catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevituṃ.
an4.262:2.3: nekkhammavitakkena, avyāpādavitakkena, avihiṃsāvitakkena, paññavā hoti ajaḷo aneḷamūgo.
an4.262:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevitunti.
